answers.core: If someone can make a GDExtension to fix this. I'd like to see them try.
answers.workaround:
- The closest I got was to set the window borderless and 0 in height, but the program still appears on the hotbar.
- I also considered using headless godot but the problem then becomes you cannot make the window visible if a crash does happen.

title: Allow hiding the main project window temporarily
